title: How can I get feedback about my child’s progress in therapy?
metaTitle: Get Feedback About Your Child’s Progress in Therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network
description: Learn how you can receive regular feedback about your child’s progress in therapy at Pinnacle Blooms Network. From meetings to progress reports, find out the ways we keep parents informed.
html: You would receive regular feedback and updates from your child's occupational therapist. Periodical meetings, informal chats, and progress reports are some ways through which we keep parents informed of their child's progress.
